outcome: Hippocampus phosphorylated cAMP-response element binding protein (p-CREB) expression
cohort: Male rats with perinatal asphyxia (PA) and Caesarean-delivered control pups.
finding: Marine collagen peptides facilitated early body weight gain and long-term learning and memory in male rats with perinatal asphyxia, by reducing oxidative damage and AChE activity and increasing p-CREB and BDNF expression in the brain.
mod_finding: Caesarean-delivered pups were used as controls, but no direct findings related to mode of birth as a primary variable were reported.
